title: Truss local web UI: the snapshot and delta messages from ui/server to the browser
description: ADR-0011, Decision 5. The data of every SSE event on GET /api/events is one of these messages, as compact JSON. ui-state (ui/server/state) produces them, ui-server (ui/server/http) carries them, ui-web (ui/web) applies them. v stays 1 until a field is renamed, retyped or removed; adding an optional field keeps 1.

snapshot.description: The whole state. Sent first on a new SSE connection, and on a reconnect whose Last-Event-ID the replay ring can't serve. Its SSE id is `<instance>:<seq>`.

seq.description: The seq of the last delta this state includes; 0 before the first delta.

delta.description: One change to the state. Its SSE id is `<instance>:<seq>`. The browser replaces each key in `set` whole, then appends `append.transcript` to its transcript and keeps the last 500 entries.

seq.description: 1 for the first delta of a server process, then +1 per delta, no gaps.

instance.description: 16 lowercase hex characters, random at each server start. A Last-Event-ID from another instance always gets a snapshot.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repo the session runs in (main.ts --repo).

trussDir.description: path is null until --truss-dir is given or the session's init message gives a session_id; exists is whether that directory is on disk now.

status.description: idle: no session yet. running: a turn is in progress. waiting: the last top-level result arrived and no turn runs. ended: the SDK's message stream finished. error: it threw.

model.description: From the latest system/init message (R-20). The UI passes no model.

plugin.description: The init plugins entry whose name is truss, or null when init lists none.

backgroundTasks.description: The tasks array of the latest system/background_tasks_changed message.

error.description: The first line of the thrown error's message, at most 500 characters, when status is error.

usage.description: From the latest result message (R-22). Both total_cost_usd and modelUsage are session totals in the recorded stream, so the latest result replaces the earlier one; nothing is summed.

costUsd.description: result total_cost_usd, or null when absent.

models.description: result modelUsage, keyed by model id, with these four counters kept.

results.description: How many result messages the session has had.

at.description: Server clock when the result arrived, RFC 3339 UTC.

n.description: 1, 2, 3 ... per server process; the browser appends only entries with n above its last.

role.description: user: text the UI sent. assistant: a text block of a top-level assistant message (no parent_tool_use_id, no agent_id). error: the session error.

requests.description: Every request this server process opened, oldest first, at most the last 200.

cancelReason.description: aborted: the canUseTool signal fired. superseded: a reply card whose session started a turn by itself. ended: the session ended with the request open.

options.description: In the order the session sent them; the brief puts the recommended one first.

answers.description: null while open; the answers sent to the session after (multiSelect labels joined with ", ").

title.description: canUseTool options.description, else input.description, else toolName.

summary.description: input.command for Bash; input.file_path for Read, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit; else JSON.stringify(input).

input.description: The tool input as canUseTool received it.

message.description: The deny message sent, else null.

text.description: The result message's result text that ended the turn.

backgroundTasks.description: How many background tasks ran when the turn ended; above 0 the session may start a turn by itself.

decision.description: allow: Approve. deny: Deny. message: the client sent a free message instead.

message.description: The text sent into the session, else null.

run.description: null while the Truss dir is unknown or not on disk.

goal.description: plan.json goal; null without a readable plan.json.

skipped.description: jsonl lines not used, at most the first 100: json = not a JSON object; version = an events line whose v isn't 1, or a messages line that has a v other than 1 (message lines carry no v today). A last line with no newline yet is not skipped; it waits.

file.description: Name relative to the Truss dir, such as events.jsonl.

crew.description: plan.json crews in plan order, then crews named only in event lines (rolled files first, by n, then events.jsonl), in order of first appearance. Crew main is never a crew.

status.description: plan.json status; null for a crew not in plan.json.

goal.description: plan.json v3 crew goal id, else null.

foreman.description: The member line of the agent whose name equals the slug.

members.description: Every other agent named in the crew's event lines, in order of first appearance.

qc.description: The newest QC file under reports/<slug>/ by the hooks' rule (isQcFile, latestQc without the run filter).

verdict.description: From a first non-empty line `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL`, else null.

file.description: Relative to the Truss dir, such as reports/auth/auth-qc-2.md.

type.description: From the agent's latest spawn line.

state.description: From the agent's latest event line.

detail.description: stalled: `<minutes> min`; tagged: the tag; reported: the marker or null; fetched: the url or query; else null.

activity.description: The crew's newest event or message line by ts; on equal ts, the one read later. A message line belongs to the crew of its from agent, else of its to agent, as the event lines name them.

text.description: spawn: `<agent> spawned`. stall: `<agent> stalled <minutes> min`. tag: `<agent> sent <tag>`. report: `<agent> reported <marker>`, or `<agent> reported` when marker is null. allowance-spent: `<agent> spent the rework allowance`. fetch: `<agent> fetched <url or query>`. incomplete: `workflow run <run> incomplete`. message: `<from> to <to>: <summary>`.

decisions.description: decisions.md, one entry per line that starts with `- `, in file order.

run.description: The text after `## Run ` of the nearest run heading above, else null.

text.description: The line without its `- `, then each following two-space continuation line without its two spaces, joined with \n.

adrs.description: The *.md files directly in the adr directory that .claude/truss.json names, sorted by file name.

title.description: The first `# ` line without `# `, else the file name.

status.description: The rest of the first line that starts with `Status: `, else null.

architecture.description: The file .claude/truss.json's architecture key names, else null.

images.description: Image files the run's crews added, read through git (ADR-0011 Decision 7). GET /api/image?ref=&path= serves only these pairs.

ref.description: The target branch, or a crew branch truss-<slug>.

notices.description: Conditions the page states in words, such as a missing .claude/truss.json or a Truss dir not on disk yet.

id.description: Stable per condition: no-config, no-truss-dir, no-plugin, git-error.

retro.description: Optional; adding it keeps v at 1. <truss dir>/retro/state.json as retro/cli.ts wrote it (docs/retro-state.schema.json, docs/adr/0012-self-improving-retro.md Decision 8): null while the file is absent, not JSON, or has a v other than 1. The steps run in the order extract, judges, triage, fixGoal, applied. ui-web renders it as the region named Retro stage.

at.description: When retro/cli.ts last set this step's status; null while pending.

detail.description: One line, at most 200 characters, such as `3 findings kept, 1 dropped`; else null.
